name: EuroSAT
description: A novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images for land use and land cover classification. The dataset covers European cities distributed in over 34 countries and includes classes such as annual crop, permanent crop, pastures, highway, residential buildings, industrial buildings, river, sea & lake, forest, and herbaceous vegetation.
creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
publisher: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI) / TU Kaiserslautern
citeAs: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth. EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification.
rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were downloaded from the Sentinel-2A satellite via Amazon S3. Images were selected from European cities covered in the European Urban Atlas, distributed over 34 European countries. Images with low cloud levels were selected. Images were recorded throughout the year to capture high variance in land use and land cover classes. A dataset of 27,000 geo-referenced and labeled image patches (64x64 pixels) was created and manually checked multiple times.
rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Secondary Data analysis
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Images full of snow or ice were sorted out. Mislabeled images were also discarded. Images with atmospheric color cast were retained intentionally to train the classifier on these cases.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral satellite images acquired by the Sentinel-2A satellite, downloaded via Amazon S3. The satellite images are openly and freely accessible through ESA's Copernicus Earth observation program. Images were associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas across 34 European countries.
rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Images were extracted from recordings made throughout the year; examples reference images from December 2015 through March 2017. Sentinel-2A was launched in June 2015.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Bands with a lower spatial resolution were upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation. RGB color space images were computed by combining the red (B04), green (B03) and blue (B02) bands. Image patches of 64x64 pixels were extracted from the satellite images.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Satellite images with low cloud coverage were selected using ESA's cloud level value. Image patches of 64x64 pixels were extracted. All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times; mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice were discarded. No atmospheric correction was applied to the dataset. The dataset was released in both RGB and multi-spectral (MS) versions.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Image patches were labeled based on the 10 land use and land cover classes defined according to the European Urban Atlas mapping guide. Ground truth was manually checked multiple times and corrected by sorting out mislabeled images.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times. Mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice were sorted out and discarded from the dataset.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables real-world Earth observation applications including land use and land cover change detection (e.g., detecting deforestation, urban development, demolition of buildings), and assistance in keeping geographical maps up-to-date (e.g., OpenStreetMap). Applications span agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change monitoring, urban development, and environmental monitoring. Deforestation detection is highlighted as particularly relevant to climate change mitigation.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset distribution is influenced by the number of cities represented per country in the European Urban Atlas. The dataset covers only European cities, which may limit generalizability. Networks pretrained on ILSVRC-2012 were initially trained only on RGB images, which may affect performance on non-RGB band combinations.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast. The spatial resolution is 10 meters per pixel, which limits the ability to distinguish fine-grained classes (e.g., churches, schools). A patch-based classification system does not allow finely graduated per-pixel segmentation. The dataset covers only European regions.
rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, and Validation of deep learning models for land use and land cover classification. The dataset can be used for benchmarking image classification methods, evaluating spectral band performance, land use and land cover change detection, and assisting in improving geographical maps. It is intended for Earth observation applications in agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change, urban development, and environmental monitoring.
